question: By what factors have LIB energy density risen and battery cost fallen, between the starting points the review gives and 2020?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), '(energy density|cost of|\$/kwh|per kwh|kwh)') ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 80
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=13 AND line_no BETWEEN 12 AND 30 OR (page=13 AND id IN ('p13.L19','p13.L20','p13.L21','p13.L22','p13.L23')) ORDER BY page, line_no

WITH e AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'from (\d+) to',1) AS DOUBLE) s, CAST(regexp_extract(text,'to (\d+) Wh',1) AS DOUBLE) f FROM lines WHERE id='p13.L20'), c AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'over \$(\d+)',1) AS DOUBLE) c0 FROM lines WHERE id='p13.L21'), c2 AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'around \$(\d+)',1) AS DOUBLE) c1 FROM lines WHERE id='p13.L22') SELECT f/s AS energy_density_factor, c0/c1 AS cost_factor_at_least FROM e, c, c2
SELECT id, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, '(126|450|55 Wh|\$1000|\$800|\$325)') AND kind IN ('figure_ocr','figure_facts','ocr','model-read') LIMIT 20

rendered: Energy density (LIBs) has risen by a factor of about 1.67[1]-fold, going from 150 to 250 Wh kg[2] since commercial debut. Battery cost has fallen by a factor of at least about 7.69[3]-fold, from over $1000 kWh^− 1 in 2008[4] to around $130 kWh^− 1 in 2020[5]. The factors are simple ratios of the review's text values; the cost factor is a minimum because the starting cost is only given as over $1000. Fig. 11[6] labels the final pack cost at $126[7] per kWh.
